description: This file contains utility classes and methods for handling errors and validating environment configurations for an OpenAI-like language model API client. It defines custom exception handling, environment validation logic, and setup for API request parameters.

classes.name: OpenAILikeError
classes.description: Custom exception class for representing errors related to OpenAI-like API interactions, encapsulating HTTP status code, message, request, and response details.

classes.name: OpenAILikeBase
classes.description: Base class providing environment validation for API key, base URL, endpoint type, and headers configuration before making API calls.

methods.name: OpenAILikeError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the error with status code and message, and prepares mock request and response objects.

methods.name: OpenAILikeBase.__init__
methods.description: Base class constructor, currently does nothing but can be extended.

methods.name: OpenAILikeBase._validate_environment
methods.description: Validates presence of API key, API base URL, headers, and configures headers accordingly; adjusts the API endpoint URL based on the endpoint type.

methods.name: Tuple[str,dict] _validate_environment( self, api_key: Optional[str], api_base: Optional[str], endpoint_type: Literal["chat_completions", "embeddings"], headers: Optional[dict], custom_endpoint: Optional[bool], )

ctags.name: _validate_environment
ctags.signature: ( self, api_key: Optional[str], api_base: Optional[str], endpoint_type: Literal["chat_completions", "embeddings"], headers: Optional[dict], custom_endpoint: Optional[bool], )
